requirements.archival_mathml: Retain original MathML in provenance, but render RAFT strings faithfully and legibly. Do not emit unexplained raw markup. Preserve fractions as explicit text such as 2½ or 1/30 when that is the source meaning, with an archival markup pointer.
requirements.table_like_text: Preserve ordered rows, columns, labels, punctuation, and line breaks for table-like lists even when no HTML table element exists. Never infer a table solely from CSS or site navigation.
requirements.voice_layers: Keep diplomatic authorial body, copied enclosures, editorial notes, later annotations, and quoted third-party text in separate fields.
requirements.visual_eligibility: A visual-dependent transcript is ineligible for text-only RAFT until the figure has been human-read, described with evidence, and linked to its exact body locator; preserving an image file alone is insufficient.

examples.quote: Außer den schon früher verzeichneten 37 mikroskopischen Organismen ... nun noch 29 andere erkennen laßen
examples.finding: The 37 and 29 counts are inline authorial text with MathML/diacritic markup; preserve numeric meaning and order.

examples.quote: Monocot. ... Dicot. ... Euphorbia origanoides ... Hedyotis Adscensionis
examples.finding: No table element exists; the ordered plant-list paragraphs are table-like content and must remain ordered rows/categories.
Two MathML fractions occur in the coach and cab travel instruction; render them as 1/4 and 1/2 while retaining original MathML provenance.
The inline fraction must become an explicit faithful string (½ or 1/2 according to the MathML value), never raw tags.
Two MathML fractions in p8 require local order and faithful string rendering (for example 1/5), with punctuation preserved.
The estimate uses 1/4 percent twice; render each fraction faithfully beside the numeric estimate rows.

examples.quote: This is to certify that after the completion of the sale of the first Edition of the Voyages of Capts. King, & FitzRoy and Mr. Darwin
examples.finding: p4 is a copied 1837 Colburn agreement embedded in Darwin's 1845 letter. Preserve it as an enclosure/quoted document with its own voice and date, not as new 1845 Darwin prose.

examples.quote: body markup includes the letter's authorial inscription and editorially linked notes
examples.finding: Preserve inscription/body text separately from later annotations and footnotes; do not attribute marginal additions to the signed author.

source_note: Hashes and locators were checked against the current preserved HTML. The two fractions whose rendered glyphs require MathML interpretation are specified as faithful rendering requirements; the quoted snippets preserve observed source text. No converter, transcript, or visual interpretation was produced.
